name: microfe-store
description: Micro Frontend Store — Next.js Shell + React/Vue/Angular MFEs

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n shell,react,vue,angular,profile,home,cart -c cyan,blue,green,red,magenta,yellow,white "cd shell-app && npm run dev" "cd mfe-react && npm run dev" "cd mfe-vue && npm run dev" "cd mfe-angular && npm run start" "cd mfe-profile && npm run dev" "cd cart && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:shell && npm run build:react && npm run build:vue && npm run build:angular && npm run build:mfe-profile && npm run build:home && npm run build:cart
scripts.install:all: cd shell-app && npm install && cd ../mfe-react && npm install && cd ../mfe-vue && npm install && cd ../mfe-angular && npm install && cd ../mfe-profile && npm install
